title: Static Echoes | ECHO//100 Episode 63
description:
Kavi-Byte battles physical chains of static while Mira hunts for a way to undo a fatal past mistake. Episode 63 of ECHO//100: Null Before Null. This is an original work of fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Jagged static ribbons erupt from the receiver, hardening into iron-tight shackles around Kavi-Byte’s ankles.
scenes.caption: Static chains bind Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi-Byte in red hoodie and white floating body, shackled to a bedroom floor by glowing black static chains.

scenes.text: Mira scans the flickering room, hunting for a reset switch hidden within this fractured memory loop.
scenes.caption: Mira scans the room
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Mira in teal holographic coat searching through a distorted, glitching 90s bedroom.

scenes.text: The static tightens, draining the cyan glow from Byte’s face as Kavi struggles to maintain form.
scenes.caption: Kavi loses physical control
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi-Byte straining against static chains, their physical form flickering and becoming translucent.

scenes.text: Mira rips a digital wallpaper strip, revealing a golden prompt glowing with a spoken-word command requirement.
scenes.caption: The switch is words
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Mira touching a glowing text prompt revealed under peeling digital wallpaper in the bedroom.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes the reset is a retraction; he must unspeak the very wish that saved his life.
scenes.caption: Retract the wish
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi-Byte looking horrified at a floating ethereal text bubble representing their past wish.

scenes.text: Null emerges, grinning with red eyes, warning that erasing the word erases Kavi’s existence entirely.
scenes.caption: Null reveals the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null with black-purple glitch skin and glowing red eyes towering over Kavi-Byte.

scenes.text: The bedroom walls dissolve into binary code as Kavi contemplates vanishing to stop the spreading glitch.
scenes.caption: The memory collapses
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, the bedroom disintegrating into digital shards, Kavi-Byte trapped in the center.

scenes.text: The dead phone rings, playing a recording of Kavi’s own voice begging from the future.
scenes.caption: Future Kavi calling
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, a close-up of a vintage phone receiver vibrating, emitting sound waves, with Kavi-Byte looking on in shock.
